object_context: Strict analytic child of RH-ANA-001. The prior exact quartet calibration showed that finite Li-prefix positivity can miss an off-critical defect. RH-ANA-002 therefore asks whether a genuinely zeta-specific all-index mechanism exists that is not merely a positive surrogate. The active obstruction is the identity/faithfulness bridge between unconditional analytic objects built from xi and the exact Li coefficients: in particular, Suzuki constructs concrete G_n in L2(R) unconditionally, while the equality lambda_n=(2pi)^(-1)||G_n||_2^2 for every n is itself equivalent to RH. Before inventing any new inequality, isolate the weakest non-circular defect/faithfulness statement that could turn an unconditional positive object or prime-side formula into all-n Li positivity.

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A sensor or transform produces a manifestly nonnegative energy norm, but that energy certifies the original signal quantity only after an exact calibration/isometry is proved; otherwise an unmeasured leakage term can carry the discrepancy.
common_abstraction: hidden defect or leakage if the map is not exact

isometry/calibration theorem -> exact all-n norm identity
shared_constraints: the map must be faithful on the full required family, not a selected finite subset

disanalogies: engineering calibration laws can be independently measured or derived, while here the desired all-n identity is itself RH-equivalent

cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Treat identity/faithfulness as a separate atomic proof obligation. Before searching for another positive norm or probability representation, expose the exact defect between the positive surrogate and lambda_n and ask whether that defect has a non-circular zeta-specific characterization.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Derive any D_n representation from unconditional identities with exact convergence and normalization; demonstrate on hostile controls that surrogate positivity can coexist with a nonzero defect; do not use RH, Li positivity, Weil positivity, model-space membership conditional on RH, or finite numerical agreement to force the defect to vanish.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned finite-field geometric positivity, Li/Weil explicit formulas, model-space norm identities, growth-class asymptotics, Parseval/isometry arguments, error-correcting/checksum metaphors, and finite-prefix diagnostics.
